description: Update an existing calendar event's fields by UID. Uses CalDAV ETag-based optimistic concurrency.

alarm.description: Single reminder in minutes before the event, or null to remove all existing alarms. For multiple reminders use alarms[].

alarms.description: Multiple reminders in minutes before the event (e.g. [1440, 60]). Replaces existing alarms; combined with alarm if both are set.

attendees.description: Replace attendees list, or null to remove all attendees

calendarName.description: The calendar name. Use list_calendars to find available calendar names.

description.description: New description, or null to remove

dtend.description: New end date/time, or null to remove

location.description: New location, or null to remove

rrule.description: New recurrence rule, or null to remove

tzid.description: IANA time zone (e.g. "Europe/Berlin") for the updated dtstart/dtend. When set, a VTIMEZONE block is added (if missing) and DTSTART/DTEND use TZID instead of UTC. Required for iOS/Thunderbird CalDAV sync.

uid.description: The UID of the event to update

name: update_event
title: Update Calendar Event
